reviewType: Assistant-assisted development review; not independent human annotation

training.provenance: Synthetic English descriptions only; no source narratives or seeker records

labelGuide.consumer: A customer dispute about bought goods or paid services, including faulty goods, non-delivery and undisclosed charges.
labelGuide.money-debt: Borrowing, repayment, credit, guarantees and debt collection. A colleague as private borrower does not by itself make this Employment.
labelGuide.employment: Employer-employee workplace matters such as wages, dismissal, leave, working hours and workplace treatment. Wage arrears are Employment, rather than a private loan.
labelGuide.other: Issues outside the three supported specific categories, such as tenancy, family, succession, education and official records.
labelGuide.unsure: Evaluation-only abstention target for sparse, genuinely unclear or mixed narratives. It is never a training class; users choose a saved category themselves.

externalReview.use: Development evaluation only; all 363 employment candidates remain pending training review
externalReview.relabelReason: Workplace complaint, workplace accommodation, and employment-related travel pay move from the old broad Other group into Employment. No Kenyan legal-procedure claims are learned from these narratives.

evaluationBoundary: All bundled evaluation cases are development evidence. Threshold selection used synthetic validation/regression outcomes; there is no completed independent Kenyan participant test.
